utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I brought my screwdriver set and a roll of duct tape for the repair drive—hope that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s great—thanks, Oren. I’m still catching up on what they need, but I’m sure that’ll come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—just point me to whatever needs fixing, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the tape and gloves covered for the repair drive. We still need a couple flashlights, screwdrivers, spare screws, and some duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I can help with whatever’s still missing for the repair drive. I’ll try to grab a couple of those things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Noah — if you can grab the flashlights or screwdrivers, that’d help a lot. We still need the spare screws and duct tape too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the donations and make a quick list of what’s missing. Faye can help coordinate around the school run if needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, that covers a lot. I can help with the drive—just tell me the time and which hauling jobs come first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Sam — I’ve got Oren down for 10, and I’ll note the screwdriver set and duct tape. I’m keeping the volunteer list updated as repairs come in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — that’s perfect. I’ll keep coordinating with Mina and send over any new repair requests as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Sam — send Mina’s requests my way and I’ll keep the list current.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds good — just confirm the time and drop-off spot, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — let’s meet at the community center at 9, and I’ll bring the donated tools over to the repair drive. Vik said he’ll swing by too and help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — 9 at the community center is confirmed, right? I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Cleo said we’re still short on screwdrivers, spare screws, and a few rolls of duct tape. Nell’s going to ask a couple neighbors about spare screws and round up the rest from around the block.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo — I’m still gathering tools and parts, and I still need a drill, a step ladder, and a couple extension cords. Dane can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails, and Rey can help too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll do that now and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira. I’ll keep the list tidy and start with the folks who need help most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Opal. I’ll listen for anyone who wants to pitch in while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Leo’s list will help a lot. I’m still gathering a few things, and if anything’s missing, Noah can help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ve got some batteries and a box or two for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. That really helps — I’ll keep gathering the rest and let Noah know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll work the repair drive around the school run. Once Leo sends the exact time and item list, and Hana confirms the drop-off time and boxes, I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive when I’ve got a minute. Gus said we still need a drill, a step ladder, and a couple extension cords, so I’ll sort the donations once they come in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll gather the names and addresses and sort them by street and urgency. With you keeping the list tidy, we’ll have this repair drive running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll help out at the repair drive, and I’ll spread the word about the plans too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Vik — thank you. I’ll gather the names and addresses and sort them by street and urgency, and Mara and Opal will keep the sign-ups and list organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out for a drill, a step ladder, and a couple extension cords. Glad Dane and Rey are helping too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is 3 PM by the community center still good for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, 3 PM by the community center still works for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and help where I can on the day. Thanks for organizing the sign-ups and lists.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, 3 PM by the community center still works. I’ll spread the word and line up a few neighbors to help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, 3 PM at the community center works for me. I’ll bring my gloves and help haul a few boxes and the small dresser.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. I’ll sort through the donations when I find a minute.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that helps a lot. I can haul a few boxes and the small dresser, but I’ll need to plan the timing carefully.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good. I’ll keep an eye out for the drill, step ladder, and extension cords, and I’ll sort the donations as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still gathering tools and parts for the repair drive. I still need a drill, a step ladder, and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm the time and drop-off spot first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can confirm that, but I don’t have the time and drop-off spot yet. I’m still checking on the details and will let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Cleo says we’re still short on screwdrivers, spare screws, and a few rolls of duct tape. Nell’s going to round up some screwdrivers and duct tape, and ask a couple neighbors about the spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll check the community center for the donated tools and bring them over. Vik’s also swinging by to help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the drop-off time and check whether we still need extra boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and spare nails for the repair drive. Just let me know what else you need me to grab.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — that covers the tools nicely. I’ll confirm the drop-off time and whether we still need extra boxes, then I’ll let you know if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam is still on for the repair drive, right? I was thinking 3 PM by the community center still works.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that still works for me. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands and let folks know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll stick with 3 PM by the community center and let Sam know too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can help haul a few boxes and that small dresser, but I’d want to make sure we’ve got the timing and truck space sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails too. If Eli gets enough notice, he can help with the hauling.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just let me know what’s still missing, and I can help with that too. We should probably double-check the truck space before we load up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll work the repair drive around the school run, and I’m still waiting on Leo’s exact time and item list. Hana can confirm the drop-off time and whether we still need extra boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word and line up a couple neighbors to help with the boxes and dresser. Once Leo sends the time and list, I’ll pass it along fast.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — that really helps. Once Leo sends the time and list, I’ll keep everyone posted and fit it around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oren said he'd be there at 10 with his screwdriver set and duct tape. I’m keeping track of the repair sign-ups, so I can match everyone with the jobs they can handle.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That helps a lot. I’m still gathering a few things, and if anything’s missing, Noah can help fill the gap.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, that should cover a lot of the small fixes. I’ll keep matching people to the repairs they’re best at so we can stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in to help, Sam — just let me know the time and which hauling jobs come first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send you the time and the first hauling jobs as soon as Mina and I lock them in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that works for me. Once you’ve got it set, send the time and the first loads, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon, but I’m still piecing together the details. If you know more, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the donations and make a quick list of what’s missing. Faye can help coordinate around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really helpful — thanks. If you can share the list when it’s ready, I’ll keep an ear out for what folks can still pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, perfect — that should cover a lot. I’ll let Cleo know the donated tools and Vik’s help are on the way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll keep the list tidy and start with the folks who need help most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I brought a screwdriver set and a roll of duct tape for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that helps. I brought some batteries and a box or two for it too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
